title: Recognizing ODEs, order and degree
objective: Classify differential equations by independent variables, highest derivative and polynomial degree when defined.
validation_requirements: Do not call degree defined until the equation is polynomial in derivatives; distinguish ODE from PDE.

title: Linearity and homogeneous terminology
objective: Distinguish linear/nonlinear ODEs and the two different uses of homogeneous.
validation_requirements: Do not confuse first-order homogeneous substitutions with homogeneous linear equations.

title: Verifying explicit and implicit solutions
objective: Check solutions by differentiating and substituting, including implicit forms.
validation_requirements: Verify residual on a stated interval; implicit differentiation and excluded values matter.

title: General, particular and singular solutions
objective: Distinguish solution families, constants, particular solutions and possible singular branches.
validation_requirements: Do not assume every general-solution formula captures every solution branch.

title: Initial-value problems and existence conditions
objective: Apply initial conditions and identify when uniqueness is or is not guaranteed.
validation_requirements: A uniqueness theorem has hypotheses; never infer uniqueness from an arbitrary formula alone.

title: Calculus refresh and method prerequisites
objective: Review chain/product rules, elementary integrations, substitutions and partial fractions.
validation_requirements: Flag a=0 exceptions, logarithmic absolute values and integration constants.

title: Recognizing separable equations
objective: Identify equations whose variables can be separated with valid algebra.
validation_requirements: Check zero-factor solutions before division by y or g(y).

title: Separable solutions and initial conditions
objective: Integrate both sides and enforce an initial condition over a valid interval.
validation_requirements: Differentiate the candidate and check the initial value; report interval/domain.

title: First-order linear standard form
objective: Recognize y'+P(x)y=Q(x) and normalize coefficient functions.
validation_requirements: Track singular points introduced by division by the leading coefficient.

title: Integrating factor derivation
objective: Construct an integrating factor and solve first-order linear ODEs.
validation_requirements: Check \mu is nonzero and the product-rule identity is valid.

title: Linear first-order initial-value problems
objective: Solve forced first-order IVPs and distinguish transient and constant terms.
validation_requirements: Substitution and initial-value check; ensure coefficient and exponent signs match.

title: Exactness criterion
objective: Test when M(x,y)dx+N(x,y)dy=0 is exact.
validation_requirements: Use common differentiable domain; matching cross-partials is a local condition.

title: Potential functions for exact equations
objective: Construct a potential F with F_x=M and F_y=N and solve F=C.
validation_requirements: Differentiate F against both components; include integration function, not just constant.

title: First-order method recognition drill
objective: Choose between separation, linear form and exactness without labels.
validation_requirements: Distractors should reflect invalid classification and unjustified division.

title: Homogeneous first-order substitution
objective: Apply y=vx or x=vy when dy/dx=F(y/x).
validation_requirements: Differentiate the substitution properly; preserve x=0 exclusions and branches.

title: Bernoulli equations
objective: Linearize y'+Py=Qy^n for n≠0,1.
validation_requirements: Track zero solutions excluded by dividing by powers of y.

title: Special integrating factors for nonexact ODEs
objective: Recognize limited sufficient tests for integrating factors depending on x or y.
validation_requirements: State hypotheses and verify exactness of the multiplied equation.

title: Substitution for shifted homogeneous forms
objective: Use translation and related substitutions on first-order first-degree equations.
validation_requirements: Verify transformations are invertible on the chosen domain.

title: Growth, decay and time constants
objective: Construct and solve proportional-rate models with physical interpretation.
validation_requirements: Check physical units, k sign, initial condition and limiting behavior.

title: Newton cooling and thermal transients
objective: Model thermal response to ambient conditions.
validation_requirements: Require consistent temperature differences, time units and assumed ambient constancy.

title: Mixing models and concentration
objective: Write and solve balance equations for a well-mixed tank.
validation_requirements: Validate volume assumptions, rates, units and nonnegative physical outputs.

title: RC and RL first-order transients
objective: Form first-order circuit ODEs from KVL/KCL and solve initial conditions.
validation_requirements: Check capacitor-voltage continuity, inductor-current continuity and time constants.

title: Linear higher-order framework
objective: Identify homogeneous linear ODEs, fundamental sets and initial-data requirements.
validation_requirements: Ensure solution count and independence assumptions are not overstated.

title: Distinct real characteristic roots
objective: Solve constant-coefficient homogeneous equations with distinct real roots.
validation_requirements: Substitute characteristic roots and verify residual.

title: Repeated characteristic roots
objective: Construct linearly independent solutions for repeated roots.
validation_requirements: Check multiplicity and linear independence.

title: Complex characteristic roots
objective: Convert conjugate roots to real exponential–trigonometric solutions.
formula: r=\alpha\pm i\beta:\ y=e^{\alpha x}(C_1\cos\beta x+C_2\sin\beta x)
validation_requirements: Verify decay sign, frequency and both initial conditions.

title: General nth-order characteristic equations
objective: Handle simple third/fourth-order constant-coefficient equations.
validation_requirements: Check total number of independent basis solutions equals order.

title: Cauchy–Euler equations
objective: Solve equidimensional equations using powers of x.
validation_requirements: Check x>0 or x<0 branch and logarithmic terms for repeated indicial roots.

title: Reduction of order
objective: Use one known solution to find a second independent solution.
validation_requirements: Verify both candidates and nonzero Wronskian on interval.

title: Higher-order IVPs and method comparison
objective: Determine constants from initial values and select appropriate methods.
validation_requirements: Check all initial conditions and avoid roundoff masking incorrect roots.

title: Complementary plus particular decomposition
objective: State the structure of nonhomogeneous linear solutions.
validation_requirements: Check the proposed particular solution produces the forcing term.

title: Undetermined coefficients: polynomial and exponential
objective: Form trial solutions for admissible elementary right-hand sides.
validation_requirements: Differentiate exact trial; verify trial class is admissible.

title: Undetermined coefficients: sinusoids
objective: Use sine/cosine trial forms with real coefficients.
validation_requirements: Check coefficients for both sine and cosine after substitution.

title: Resonance and trial adjustment
objective: Multiply a trial by enough powers of x when forcing overlaps with homogeneous solutions.
validation_requirements: Verify resonance multiplicity and linearly independent particular trial.

title: Variation of parameters
objective: Solve forcings unsuitable for undetermined coefficients.
validation_requirements: Use normalized equation; check Wronskian and integral domain.

title: Initial conditions on forced equations
objective: Combine complementary/particular parts and enforce initial data.
validation_requirements: Require residual and both initial-condition checks.

title: Second-order RLC circuit models
objective: Form second-order RLC equations using energy-storage relationships.
validation_requirements: Check charge-current convention, dimensions and damping classification.

title: Forced response and resonance interpretation
objective: Compare natural and forced behavior and assess physical reasonableness.
validation_requirements: Differentiate between mathematical resonance, forced response and circuit assumptions.

title: Laplace definition and existence basics
objective: Compute a transform from the integral definition for admissible functions.
validation_requirements: State conditions on s and function growth.

title: Transform table and linearity
objective: Recognize common transforms and apply linearity.
validation_requirements: Check n integer nonnegative and convergence region.

title: Trigonometric and exponential shift transforms
objective: Use trigonometric pairs and s-shifting.
validation_requirements: Check numerator and frequency square, shift direction.

title: Transforms of derivatives and initial data
objective: Transform derivatives and incorporate initial conditions.
validation_requirements: Check signs for every initial-condition term.

title: Inverse transforms using partial fractions
objective: Decompose rational transforms into table pairs.
validation_requirements: Check partial-fraction reconstruction and forward-transform result.

title: Inverse transforms of shifted quadratics
objective: Complete squares and identify damped sine/cosine forms.
validation_requirements: Check transform amplitude, exponential sign, and frequency.

title: Transforms involving time powers and integrals
objective: Apply differentiation in s and integration properties.
validation_requirements: Check derivative under transform and existence conditions.

title: Laplace method-selection and algebra drill
objective: Choose between lookup, shifting, decomposition and definition.
validation_requirements: Independently forward-transform the chosen answer and test equivalent options.

title: Laplace solution of first-order IVPs
objective: Solve first-order ODEs by transforming initial-value data.
validation_requirements: Verify back-substitution, initial condition and time-domain solution.

title: Laplace solution of higher-order IVPs
objective: Solve second-order IVPs with zero or nonzero initial data.
validation_requirements: Check every initial term, partial fraction and time-domain residual.

title: Heaviside functions and piecewise inputs
objective: Represent switching signals using unit-step functions.
validation_requirements: Check switch instants and continuity/jump convention.

title: Second shifting and delayed forcing
objective: Transform delayed functions and recover time-shifted responses.
validation_requirements: Check delay parameter a≥0, correct argument (t-a) and zero pre-delay response.

title: Impulse forcing and Dirac delta
objective: Use delta transforms to determine jump-driven responses.
validation_requirements: Check integrated jump condition and causal interpretation.

title: Convolution theorem and response
objective: Interpret response as convolution and apply elementary integral pairs.
validation_requirements: Verify limits and product-of-transforms identity; keep examples board-relevant.

title: RLC transients via Laplace
objective: Solve a step-forced circuit with physical initial conditions.
validation_requirements: Check units, continuity, damping regime and limiting values.

title: Integrated Laplace exam method selection
objective: Select an efficient path for inverse transforms, IVPs, delays and impulses.
validation_requirements: Check transform consistency, domain, independent answer equivalence and time efficiency.
